parsed.explanation: No criminalisation, no documented border or facility restriction, no custody rule, and a functioning court granting recognition (2007, July 2024) plus pride events, inclusive curriculum and active NGOs are real positives; silence on police targeting in this well-documented dossier is mildly favourable. Against that: dated-Nov-2024 evidence of discrimination in public spaces and government institutions with frequent physical/sexual harassment of visibly trans people (tier-3 hostility, thin recourse), pervasive stigma, conversion therapy, weak document practice (mainly resident-facing), limited HRT access for a traveller needing refills, and a very recent trajectory of hate speech from the head of government with death threats from supporters. No universal state exposure or organised targeting is documented, so this sits in Elevated Risk, at the top of it.
